commands.text: Computer, show me a shoulder shimmy in a mustard yellow tracksuit.

events.text: Computer, show me a shoulder shimmy in a mustard yellow tracksuit.

events.label: MUSTARD_SHIMMY_KING
events.motion: Stand upright facing forward. From the shoulders, alternate rapid lateral shimmy movements side to side, shoulders rising and falling slightly. Arms hang relaxed at sides, moving subtly with shoulder motion. Maintain steady head position, slight forward lean. Repeat continuous shimmy for five seconds.
events.costume: Mustard yellow tracksuit with zipper jacket and matching pants, white sneakers, preserved eyeglasses.

events.motion: The dancer orients three-quarters toward screen left, sliding the right foot backward toward screen right over one second, then the left foot follows, moving the whole body a small distance backward across the floor.
